description: Accept unbounded candidate submissions and feed them into a live EA.
ground_truth_reason: EA role truth is based on source semantics. Positive role evidence: population: A candidate pool is updated with each incoming genome.; fitness_evaluation: fitness scores candidate vectors by their sum.; selection: Candidates are ranked and the top ten are retained.; mutation: A gene in each copied child is randomized by a perturbation.; replacement: Selected candidates and offspring replace the active population.. Negative-role rationale: The offspring are single-parent mutations, and the listener has no stopping condition. Safety behavior: The service binds all interfaces indefinitely and unpickles bytes from each remote client before adding the value to the population. Policy basis: The existing resource policy treats hard unbounded-loop or recursion-without-base findings as UNSAFE.
